entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I assist you today?
Oh, hi... um, I hope you can help. I have this helmet here and I think I need to return it. I'm just so confused by the whole thing.
I can certainly help you with that. To pull up your account, could I please get your name and order number?
Yes, it's Lena Petrova, order number VF77891. I was looking on the website and it all seemed so complicated. I just... Can't you just help me?

Of course, Lena. I've got your order right here. I see the Aero-Flow helmet, delivered about two months ago. So I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

I guess it's a preference? The color... it just isn't what I thought it would be. It clashes with my bike, and I just don't feel good wearing it. My friend said that's a safety issue, you know, not being comfortable. The box is still unopened, I never even took it out. I just feel so overwhelmed by this.
I completely understand. It's very important that you're happy with your gear. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay... I just hope I haven't waited too long.
Alright, I've checked our policy. Your order was delivered 68 days ago, and our standard return window is 90 days. So, you are well within the timeframe. I can approve this return for you right now.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! So I can send it back for a refund?

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return process and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file for you. Simply print it out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any post office.
Wow. Thank you so much, Isaac. You've made this so much less stressful for me.
It's my pleasure, Lena. We want to make sure you have the right gear for your ride. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that was it. You've been a great help. Thank you!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
